The '''Ord Radama Spaceport Authority''' was an independent agency that ran the [[Livien Magnus spaceport]]. The agency was overseen by the [[Planetary Governor/Legends|planetary governor]] and controlled arrivals, depatures, and security.<ref name="OaA1" />
